purpose: Test whether causal reconstruction of forecast-time transient missing inputs preserves downstream SEP forecast utility better than simple causal recovery or abstention, without treating reconstructed values as observations or fabricating structurally unavailable historical measurements.

missingness_classes.STRUCTURAL_UNAVAILABLE: Feature/modality was not authoritatively available in the source/instrument regime. Never treat reconstruction as a recovered observation; handle through source-era modeling, missing masks, fallback or abstention.
missingness_classes.TRANSIENT_MISSING: Feature/modality is supported in the source regime but is absent/stale for a particular issue. Eligible for the preregistered reconstruction comparison if forecast-time provenance is available.
missingness_classes.OBSERVED: Authoritative forecast-time measurement is available and passes source/freshness checks.

missingness_scenarios.natural: preserve observed historical source missingness with masks and separate authoritative structural unavailability from transient gaps
missingness_scenarios.synthetic_random: deterministic random held-out values inside structurally supported train-only cells
missingness_scenarios.synthetic_block: contiguous outage-style gaps of predeclared durations inside structurally supported source eras and appropriate to each source cadence
missingness_scenarios.modality_dropout: remove complete forecast-time modalities inside supported source eras to test fallback, degradation and abstention

physics_arm_requires: gap is transient inside an authoritatively supported source regime
downstream performance is compared on identical masked issue identities
no material calibration degradation versus the best surviving nonphysics recovery arm
lower forecast degradation than the best surviving nonphysics recovery arm on predeclared missingness scenarios
survival_gate.failure_action: Do not include the physics reconstruction in the frozen final model; retain the negative result.

full_mhd_policy.role: candidate external physics reconstruction or feature provider for supported transient gaps only
full_mhd_policy.reason: A full MHD state is model output, not recovered sensor truth. It cannot retroactively create an unavailable historical instrument measurement and must demonstrate downstream value before inclusion.
minimum_requirements: source regime authoritatively supports the reconstructed quantity
runtime feasible for the declared research setting
state-to-feature mapping frozen before score evaluation
comparison against simpler physics and nonphysics recovery baselines

claim_boundary: No claim of accurate solar-flare simulation, operational certification, named-company superiority, economic savings, breakthrough, award outcome or final NEW-crossing improvement follows from this contract alone.
